items.headline: Man Utd confirm Champions League squad for Sabah clash
items.summary: Manchester United added eight players to their Champions League squad ahead of Thursday's UEFA league phase match against Sabah FC.

items.headline: Lisandro Martinez enters final year of contract with no extension agreed
items.summary: Argentine defender Lisandro Martinez has entered the final year of his Manchester United contract and contract extension talks remain unresolved.

items.headline: Andrey Santos earns reward for strong start to Old Trafford career
items.summary: Summer signing Andrey Santos has impressed at Manchester United following his arrival from Benfica in the 2026 transfer window.

items.headline: Man Utd close to new contracts for Kobbie Mainoo and Harry Maguire
items.summary: Manchester United are close to agreeing new contract extensions with midfielder Kobbie Mainoo and defender Harry Maguire.

items.headline: Carrick hints at transfer market difficulties after missing summer targets
items.summary: Michael Carrick has referenced problems Manchester United faced in the transfer market after failing to complete deals for several targeted players.
